1. **Chart type**  
   - Two-panel **line chart** (time-series line charts).

2. **Layout techniques**  
   - **Faceting / small multiples**: two side-by-side panels comparing:
     - **Ten most vaccinated states**
     - **Ten least vaccinated states**
   - Each panel contains **two colored lines** for age groups.
   - A **shaded vertical band** marks a recent period labeled “REPORTING DELAYS POSSIBLE.”

3. **Data variables**

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date | Temporal | Position on x-axis |
| New daily hospital admissions per 100,000 people | Quantitative | Position on y-axis |
| Age group (Adults, Under 18) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of line; end labels |
| State group / vaccination category (Ten most vaccinated states, Ten least vaccinated states) | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into left and right panels; panel titles |
| Reporting-delay period | Temporal interval | Shaded vertical band/background region with text label |

After that, the number of cases remained somewhat constant. For the kids, the cases remained consistently low throughout May-the first 6 days of September.

One September drew nearer, the number of cases gradually decreased. When it cames to the kids, they experienced a steady increase in the rate of Covid cases throughout the month of August.

image_description:
1. **Chart type**  
   - Two-panel **line chart** (time-series line charts).

2. **Layout techniques**  
   - **Faceting / small multiples**: two side-by-side panels comparing:
     - **Ten most vaccinated states**
     - **Ten least vaccinated states**
   - Each panel contains **two colored lines** for age groups.
   - A **shaded vertical band** marks a recent period labeled “REPORTING DELAYS POSSIBLE.”

3. **Data variables**

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date | Temporal | Position on x-axis |
| New daily hospital admissions per 100,000 people | Quantitative | Position on y-axis |
| Age group (Adults, Under 18) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of line; end labels |
| State group / vaccination category (Ten most vaccinated states, Ten least vaccinated states) | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into left and right panels; panel titles |
| Reporting-delay period | Temporal interval | Shaded vertical band/background region with text label |

   - Two-panel **line chart** (time-series line charts).

2. **Layout techniques**  
   - **Faceting / small multiples**: two side-by-side panels comparing:
     - **Ten most vaccinated states**
     - **Ten least vaccinated states**
   - Each panel contains **two colored lines** for age groups.
   - A **shaded vertical band** marks a recent period labeled “REPORTING DELAYS POSSIBLE.”

3. **Data variables**

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date | Temporal | Position on x-axis |
| New daily hospital admissions per 100,000 people | Quantitative | Position on y-axis |
| Age group (Adults, Under 18) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of line; end labels |
| State group / vaccination category (Ten most vaccinated states, Ten least vaccinated states) | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into left and right panels; panel titles |
| Reporting-delay period | Temporal interval | Shaded vertical band/background region with text label |
raw_comment:
I notice that for the ten most vaccinated states, the increase, and average in general, was a lot lower than for the ten least vaccinated states. For adults in the ten most vaccinated states, things were going pretty well until the delta variant was discovered. For adults in the other graph, things were going even better, starting out at about a 2.7 ish, and decreasing to a 1.5 ish. But after the variant was discovered, things took quite a dramatic turn. The more vaccinated adults shot up, back to 3 admissions, but that increase paled in comparison with the increase in the less vaccinated states- going from 1.5 ish, to 9.5 ish. For teens in the vaccinated states, life was pretty dull, remaining at about 0.5 ish the entire time. Teens in the less vaccinated states fared less well, staying at a constant three quarters before the variant was discovered and it shot up to 2 and a half. 
Headline: The Covid Rollercoaster

Today’s graphs show the number of hospital admissions per 100,000 people for the ten most and least vaccinated states.  The time series graphs are for May 1 - September 6, 2021.  The first cases of the Delta variant of Covid were identified in Texas on May 20.  

From 9 am – 2 pm E.T. today, share with us your responses online to these three questions -- "What do you notice?",  "What do you wonder?", and “How does this relate to you and your community?”
